version: 4.3.0 / macros 2.2.0 candidate; no publication authorized by this artifact

architecture.engine: Relay contains one Router. No RelayInner, separate transport/discovery/reliability/queues remain.
architecture.config: One RouterConfig implementation and shared SideOptions. RelayConfig is a compatibility adapter into immutable forwarding-only role. No public role switch.
architecture.optional_services: Forwarding role allocates no local application config, managed-variable/P2P service state, ISR ingress service, or local timesync runtime. Transit protocol discovery/clock allowance/ACK/replay still use shared engine.
architecture.receipt_cache: Lazy forwarded receipt cache uses pre-existing reliable entry/sender count limits. Like the old Relay cache, its map allocation is allocator-visible and count-bounded, not included in max_queue_budget; queue/replay payloads remain charged once.
architecture.legacy_protocol_namespace: E2EACK sender namespace remains protocol compatibility, not an application-name routing heuristic. No literal RELAY destination exclusion.

compatibility.public_apis: Legacy Rust Relay constructors/methods/2-variant TX enum/config aliases remain; C/Python adapters use canonical shared config.
compatibility.queued_ingress: Relay RX remains enqueue-only and drain does not initiate periodic discovery.
compatibility.callback: Busy/refusal ownership, hard errors, same-side serialization, independent-side progress and reentrant RX deferral are covered by retained regressions.
compatibility.sender: Relay rename changes protocol sender without originating application address-change notification.
compatibility.stats: One retained queue projects original TX and ReliableReplay markers into legacy separate stats, with no double budget charge. Public runtime and memory-JSON regression included.
compatibility.wire: Five public old/new constructor profiles, ten canonical packet identities each direction. Actual frozen old c324 receiver consumes new frames byte-identically after full CRC decode. Default, explicit header=false + chunks110, template, small_packet110, header=false frame400 FULL/COMPACT.
compatibility.wire_tradeoff: Side-local template/transfer IDs differ; hashed template IDs can add four wire bytes versus old incremental IDs. No canonical payload/ID/source/timestamp changes. Throughput still requires all7 qualification.
compatibility.synthetic_fixture_correction: Private synthetic FULL/chunk fixtures now explicitly declare templates they construct. Public old constructor implicit-template behavior is separately preserved by thin options normalization. No loss/identity assertion removed.

tests.arm128: embedded + compact-packet-store, MAX_STACK_PAYLOAD=128, thumbv7em-none-eabihf strict Clippy PASS
tests.minimal: no-default-features rlib panic=abort PASS zero warnings; unused helpers genuinely feature-gated, no blanket allowance
tests.earlier_failures: First through fourth shared-engine parity failures and overstrict new wire equality test logs are preserved; final assertions cover actual shared owners and both full decoders.

compiler_layout.scope: Compiler object layout, not linked all-seven or peak allocator qualification. Heap boxes and lazy receipt caches must also be charged; descriptor sizes can change fixed-byte queue capacities.

memory.mandatory_followup: All seven linked static/allocator highwater and throughput/latency campaigns, TLSF+compact ON, including gateway DAQ; no pool/rate/gate inflation.
